lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003eoperó:
"

The lac operon of E. coli groups three genes that are transcribed together: lacZ (β-galactosidase, which breaks down lactose), lacY (permease) and lacA (transacetylase). Upstream are the promoter (P) and the operator (O). The regulatory gene lacI produces the repressor, which binds to the operator.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003egluco:
"

Glucose is the preferred source. When it is abundant, cAMP is low and the activator CAP does not bind to the promoter: even with lactose, transcription is low (catabolite repression, positive control). Without glucose, CAP–cAMP helps recruit the polymerase and expression is maximal.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa lactosa se convier:
"

Lactose is converted into allolactose, the inducer, which binds to the repressor and changes its shape: the repressor lets go of the operator. RNA polymerase transcribes lacZYA, a polycistronic mRNA forms and all three enzymes appear.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSin lactosa, el \u003:
"

Without lactose, the LacI repressor binds to the operator and blocks RNA polymerase: there is almost no transcription (basal expression ≈ 1–2 %). The cell does not spend energy on enzymes it does not need: this is negative control.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eUn mutante \u003cb\u0:
"

A lacI⁻ mutant produces no functional repressor; a lacOᶜ mutant has an operator to which the repressor cannot bind. In both cases the operon is expressed constitutively, even without lactose. Predict the expression under each condition and check.

"
lit.\u0027«Expresión en las cuatro condicion: '“Expression in the four conditions” of lactose and glucose.'

lit.\u0027Con glucosa baja el AMPc, no se fo: "With glucose, cAMP is low, CAP–cAMP does not form and the promoter is weak"
lit.\u0027Con lactosa y sin glucosa la expre: 'With lactose and no glucose expression is maximal; add glucose and it drops (low cAMP, inactive CAP).'
lit.\u0027El inductor real del operón lac es: "The true inducer of the lac operon is…"
lit.\u0027El represor bloquea al operador y: "The repressor blocks the operator and RNA polymerase does not advance"
lit.\u0027El represor no reconoce el operado: "The repressor does not recognize the operator."
lit.\u0027Elige lactosa, glucosa y cepa. Ver: "Choose lactose, glucose and strain. You will see whether the repressor blocks the operator, whether the polymerase advances and how much mRNA and enzyme are formed."
lit.\u0027Elige un mutante lacI⁻ o lacOᶜ: ha: 'Pick a lacI⁻ or lacOᶜ mutant: there is expression even without lactose (constitutive).'
lit.\u0027en la parte inferior se acumulan e: 'mRNA and enzymes (β-galactosidase) pile up at the bottom when the operon is transcribed.'
lit.\u0027esfera morada = represor LacI; esf: 'purple sphere = LacI repressor; blue sphere = RNA polymerase; octahedron = CAP–cAMP.'
lit.\u0027Hidroliza lactosa a glucosa y gala: "It hydrolyzes lactose into glucose and galactose."

lit.\u0027se une al promotor y la activa\u00: "binds to the promoter and activates it"
